items.headline: Low Water Advisory issued November 27 at 12:21PM CST until November 27 at 9:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...Abnormally low water levels.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM CST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Negative tide levels can result in hazardous
navigating conditions.
items.instruction:
Mariners should navigate shallow waters with extreme caution due
to below normal water levels.
